title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Myth
description: Many property owners assume pouring chemical drain cleaners down a sink is a safe and effective solution for any clog. In reality, strong chemical drain openers rely on harsh caustic reactions that generate intense heat. This heat can warp thin PVC piping, degrade rubber seals, and corrode older metal lines. Additionally, if the obstruction is caused by root intrusion, broken pipes, or improper slope, chemical treatments will fail completely while leaving standing acid or lye in the pipe, creating a safety hazard for technicians. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical clearing tools like drain augers to clear blockages safely without compromising the piping.
